description: The single object a parent passes to a child component: `<Avatar name="Ada" />` calls `Avatar({ name: 'Ada' })`.
Destructuring default `({ size = 64 })`. Applies when the prop is missing or `undefined`.
Legacy static defaults. Removed for function components in React 19; still valid on classes.
`<Child {...props} />` forwards every prop. Combine with `...rest` destructuring to forward the remaining ones.
Props are read-only snapshots. Never reassign or mutate them; use state for values that change.
